The '''SkySlayer''' was a model of light assault [[Starship/Legends|starship]] manufactured by [[Aratech Repulsor Company/Legends|Aratech Repulsor Company]]. The ''[[Grasp]]'', owned by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Teehl]], was an Aratech SkySlayer.<ref name="SH">[[Scavenger Hunt (adventure)|''Scavenger Hunt'']]</ref>
